## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL, as specified in the data; risk and cycle signals are unavailable, while breadth is strong at 11/11 sectors positive on the week. Leadership: Intermediate (3 sectors in the Top 5); the positive weekly breadth contrasts with Technology’s negative monthly return and several major-stock divergences, so the data does not support a stronger regime call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads on the week (+6.25%), with MPC (1W: +11.24% | 1M: -13.06%) RECOVERY and VLO (1W: +9.63% | 1M: -14.46%) RECOVERY; Technology is next (+4.28%), with AVGO (1W: +18.16% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND. Communication is also strong (+3.52% weekly, +5.03% monthly), led by CHTR (1W: +17.21% | 1M: +25.82%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Discretionary (+0.68%), Healthcare (+1.05%) and Real Estate (+1.32%) were the weakest sectors on the week, though all remained positive. Within the available names, F (1W: -3.10% | 1M: -2.08%) is BELOW TREND and PFE (1W: -1.70% | 1M: -0.44%) is BELOW TREND; constituent-level breadth for these sectors was not provided.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMD (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%) RECOVERY, AVGO (1W: +18.16% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND, CHTR (1W: +17.21% | 1M: +25.82%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +12.71% | 1M: -18.58%) RECOVERY and CEG (1W: +12.10% | 1M: +1.89%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Intermediate (3 sectors); Technology supplies three of the five leaders, but leadership is not concentrated within two sectors.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NVDA (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -25.03%) BELOW TREND, NEM (1W: -6.43% | 1M: -2.29%) BELOW TREND, SYK (1W: -4.98% | 1M: +5.60%) CORRECTION, ACN (1W: -3.84% | 1M: +11.37%) CORRECTION and COF (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -1.90%) BELOW TREND. Weakness spans Technology, Materials, Healthcare, Financials and Technology services.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest weekly moves: AMD (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%) RECOVERY, AVGO (1W: +18.16% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND and CHTR (1W: +17.21% | 1M: +25.82%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergences include AMD (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: +3.86% | 1M: -15.31%) RECOVERY, META (1W: +5.17% | 1M: -12.90%) RECOVERY and CAT (1W: +7.44% | 1M: -18.22%) RECOVERY: transitional tape; watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weekly sector performance is positive (+4.28%), but the monthly average remains weak (-9.21%); constituent-level positive counts were not supplied. A sharp split: AAPL (1W: +4.14% | 1M: +4.25%) ABOVE TREND and AVGO (1W: +18.16% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND contrast with NVDA (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -25.03%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -1.27% | 1M: -2.88%) BELOW TREND; GOOGL (1W: +3.86% | 1M: -15.31%) and META (1W: +5.17% | 1M: -12.90%) are RECOVERY.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials show positive sector returns (+2.59% weekly, +4.11% monthly); constituent-level positive counts were not supplied. JPM (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +3.18%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +6.70%) ABOVE TREND and MA (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +7.28%) ABOVE TREND contrast with COF (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -1.90%) BELOW TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare gained +1.05% on the week and +4.62% over the month; constituent-level positive counts were not supplied. Leadership is firm in LLY (1W: +6.74% | 1M: +15.47%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.45% | 1M: +12.82%) ABOVE TREND and UNH (1W: +3.38% | 1M: +0.19%) ABOVE TREND, while PFE (1W: -1.70% | 1M: -0.44%) is BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor diversified exposure rather than a strong Growth or Value tilt: sector returns are positive across all 11 sectors, but leadership is mixed and monthly Technology weakness persists. Monitor NVDA (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -25.03%) BELOW TREND and the RECOVERY patterns in AMD (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%) and CAT (1W: +7.44% | 1M: -18.22%); style mixed / no clear leadership.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%) RECOVERY, if the weekly rebound persists and the monthly trend improves; JPM (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +3.18%) ABOVE TREND, if financial strength holds. BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -25.03%) BELOW TREND, if weakness continues; COF (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -1.90%) BELOW TREND, with credit-card policy headlines an added risk.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy, up +6.25% for the week, if its leaders’ rebounds extend; Communication, up +3.52% weekly and +5.03% monthly, on stronger trend confirmation. BEARISH: Technology, despite a +4.28% weekly gain, remains down 9.21% over the month; constituent-level breadth counts were not supplied, so monitor whether the rebound broadens.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Price levels were not provided, so numeric support and resistance cannot be assessed. Monitor whether AMD (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%) RECOVERY turns its monthly return positive, whether NVDA (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -25.03%) BELOW TREND stabilizes, and whether JPM (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +3.18%) ABOVE TREND sustains its advance.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AMD (+50): Oppenheimer upgrade and reported demand strength; its weekly surge confirms positive news, but AMD (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%) remains RECOVERY. TSLA (+60): Cybercab announcement; TSLA (1W: +8.93% | 1M: +7.66%) ABOVE TREND confirms the positive catalyst, though negative headlines also surfaced. V (+45): analyst target increases; V (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +6.70%) ABOVE TREND is consistent with improving sentiment.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
COF (-45): proposed credit-card rate cap; COF (1W: -3.36% | 1M: -1.90%) BELOW TREND confirms the negative news. TSLA (-55): separate market-value-loss headlines conflict with its positive Cybercab coverage; TSLA (1W: +8.93% | 1M: +7.66%) ABOVE TREND has not yet confirmed that negative sentiment.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL is the supplied regime; breadth is 11/11 sectors positive on the week, but style is mixed / no clear leadership. Relative strength includes CHTR (1W: +17.21% | 1M: +25.82%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +3.18%) ABOVE TREND, while AMD (1W: +18.93% | 1M: -5.01%) remains RECOVERY. Monitor major monthly-versus-weekly divergences and the conflicting TSLA headlines; NVDA (1W: -12.75% | 1M: -25.03%) remains BELOW TREND.
